summary: Boss Private Clients is a boutique Melbourne CBD accounting and advisory practice (23 staff on LinkedIn, workforce split between Australia and the Philippines) acting for private clients and family businesses. It runs a visible bookkeeping team alongside its accountants and has made recent hires (a bookkeeper in January 2026, a senior accountant in May 2026). Director Sam Marzano focuses on entity structures and wealth planning for family businesses.

hooks.text: Sam advises family businesses using companies, trusts and SMSFs, so each client has several entities to reconcile; the firm has a dedicated bookkeeping team doing that load.
Recent hiring (bookkeeper Jan 2026, senior accountant May 2026) and +23% headcount growth suggest volume is outpacing capacity.
Offshore (Philippines) staff mean review and audit trail matter more than raw speed.

risks.text: Account record lists Daniel Cuda as Founder; the firm site shows him as a Manager (accountant since 2017). Directors are Sam Marzano, Sam Cimino, Peter Stranges, Paul Troiano.

Email check: the firm's people page appears to list sam@ for Sam Cimino and smarzano@ for Sam Marzano, but accounts.json has sam@ for Sam Marzano. Verify the address before sending (the people page layout is ambiguous).
Fit is private-client tax/structuring led, with bookkeeping a supporting line; weak-to-moderate fit.

gaps: No firm blog, newsletters, podcasts, Facebook posts or news coverage found.
No public job ad or evidence of a specific reconciliation tool (no Dext/Hubdoc/AI mentions).
Could not confirm the Philippines claim from the firm's own site; it comes from LinkedIn aggregate data.
